title: How To Start Day Trading As A Beginner In 2025 [Full Tutorial]
summary: A day-trading educator teaches candles, risk-based position sizing, trendlines, Fibonacci and fair-value-gap setups, backtesting via chart replay, leverage and prop firms, promising daily returns that investing cannot match.

assertions.quote: We can have multiple of these opportunities in a single day, which allows us to go from making say $30 in a year

verdicts.note: Large studies of retail day traders in Brazil, Taiwan and the US find the large majority lose money and almost none earn a living; the comparison ignores costs and loss frequency.
Persistent futures day traders had negative expected daily profit (mean -US$48.81, 97% losing) with large volatility, the opposite of earning a year's investment return in a day at equal risk.

assertions.quote: We lost 70% of the time, winning 30% of the time, which is going to give us a net total of plus 3.8 risk factors.
This is the most important part that will either make or break any progress that you make throughout this process.

verdicts.note: Behavioural biases do hurt traders, but no amount of discipline creates an edge where none exists; psychology explains failure more than it produces success.

assertions.quote: All for some reason fall around this specific Fibonacci value, which often times will lead the price to revert cleanly down to that level

verdicts.note: Academic tests of Fibonacci and similar chart levels find no predictive power beyond chance; the golden-ratio-in-nature justification is numerology.

assertions.quote: The next would be do using a simulated account. Okay? And then after that, you would actually apply this onto a real account.
if we use 10x leverage, would take 6,800 and only require us to use $683.

verdicts.note: Mechanically true for the stop-loss case, but gaps, slippage, funding costs and liquidation mean losses are not actually capped at the planned amount.

ESMA: leverage increases possible losses as well as gains, raises the probability of a larger loss more than of a larger gain for retail clients, and makes positions vulnerable to margin calls on small moves; the amount at risk is not fixed.

assertions.quote: this is where leverage or using prop firms is going to be important

verdicts.note: Evaluation-based prop firms do fund some traders, but most participants pay repeated evaluation fees and fail; the fees are the firms' main revenue.

assertions.quote: Basically shows you when the markets are perceived to be undervalued or overvalued.

verdicts.note: Oscillator-style indicators are lagging transforms of price; no independent evidence shows paid indicator suites produce an edge after costs.
